purpose: Migrate the frozen HU ENS8@10105 to the already-validated V1+30-semantic Advantage architecture and continue HU-only semantic-online training without touching THREE_HANDED.

semantic_architecture.feature_contract: Same domain-agnostic made-hand/pair-relation/overcard/draw/board-texture vector validated in THREE_HANDED.
semantic_architecture.member_fit_seed_contract: Reuse each source HU ENS8 member init_seed and batch_seed; semantic members are freshly fit from the current HU Advantage reservoir each update.
semantic_architecture.behavior: Mean eight raw semantic-Advantage outputs then unchanged lean regret matching.

migration_gate.zero_column_embedding: Copy every V1 parameter exactly and append 30 exact-zero columns to body.0.weight for every source HU member.
migration_gate.rule: Parity is mechanical only. After parity passes, fit the initial semantic ENS8 fresh1600 on the remaining 1.95M HU reservoir entries before collecting any new roots.

training.sampler: Resume frozen 10105 sampler RNG state and draw TRUE_HEADS_UP episodes only.
training.root_behavior: Current semantic ENS8 raw-output mean + unchanged lean regret matching.
training.refit: After each root block, refit all eight semantic members fresh1600 from the updated HU Advantage reservoir excluding the fixed 50k diagnostic positions.

hard_stop_conditions: Source checkpoint or source HU ensemble hash drift.
Any non-finite fit loss or model tensor.
Any mutation of frozen source artifacts.
non_goals: No strength benchmark during this training block.
result: PASS freezes a new HU semantic ENS8 teacher endpoint after 128037 additional HU roots. PASS is a training/integrity result, not a strength claim.
